services.name: Basic Facial
services.desc: A thorough cleanse, exfoliation, extractions where needed, mask and moisturise. A good reset for dull or congested skin and a solid first appointment if you are new to facials.

services.name: Oxygen Facial
services.desc: A hydrating facial that delivers a serum into the skin with pressurised oxygen, leaving it fresh and plumped straight after.

services.name: Oxygen Therapy Facial
services.desc: A longer oxygen-based facial with added treatment steps for skin that needs more hydration and brightening.

services.name: XFC Facial
services.desc: A results-focused facial using concentrated actives to target dullness, texture and early ageing.

services.name: Acne Treatment
services.desc: A targeted session for active breakouts — deep cleansing, extractions and calming actives. Works best as part of a series alongside a home routine your therapist will recommend.

services.name: High Frequency Facial
services.desc: A finishing step that passes a low-level current over the skin, often added after extractions on blemish-prone skin.

services.name: LED Red Light
services.desc: A short session under red light, usually added onto another treatment to calm and support the skin.

services.name: Dr Shrammek fresher
services.desc: The gentlest of the Dr Schrammek peels — a light resurfacing treatment for a brighter, smoother finish with minimal disruption.

services.name: Consultation
services.desc: A one-on-one skin assessment with your therapist to agree the right plan for your concerns. Redeemable against your first treatment.

services.name: Pigmentation
services.desc: A treatment aimed at lightening sun spots and uneven tone. Suitability depends on your skin type and is assessed first; a course is usually advised.

services.name: Microneedling
services.desc: Fine needles create controlled micro-channels to prompt the skin’s own collagen response, used for texture, scarring and fine lines. Course length and downtime are discussed at consultation.

services.name: Derma Peel
services.desc: A professional exfoliating peel to resurface dull, congested or uneven skin. Strength is tailored to you; a few days of light flaking can be normal.

services.name: Derma Peel + Microneedle
services.desc: A peel followed by microneedling in one appointment, combining surface resurfacing with deeper collagen stimulation.

services.name: Green Sea Spicules (Peel)
services.desc: A resurfacing treatment using natural marine spicules to exfoliate and renew the skin over the following days.

services.name: Dr Schrammek Energy
services.desc: A mid-strength Dr Schrammek peel for skin that needs more correction than the Fresher but a shorter recovery than the Classic.

services.name: Dr shrammek classic (Green Peel)
services.desc: The original herbal Green Peel — an intensive resurfacing treatment with visible peeling over several days and a smoother, fresher result.

services.name: Advanced repair and restore
services.desc: A full-face treatment focused on repairing and strengthening tired, stressed skin.

services.name: Prevention & Restore
services.desc: A treatment aimed at slowing early signs of ageing while restoring hydration and radiance.

services.name: Rejuvenating Cell Renewal
services.desc: A renewal treatment designed to kick-start cell turnover for brighter, more even skin.

services.name: RF Anti-Wrinkle
services.desc: Radiofrequency warmth applied to the skin to firm and soften the look of fine lines. Results build gradually over a course.

services.name: Hollywood Laser Face Treatment
services.desc: A gentle laser facial that works over the whole face for an immediate glow and refined texture, with no real downtime.

services.name: Lip Contour
services.desc: A non-surgical treatment to define and subtly enhance the lip border and shape.

services.name: Double chin
services.desc: An injectable treatment to address fullness under the chin. Requires a consultation to confirm suitability.

services.name: Jet Plasma Ozone
services.desc: A no-needle plasma treatment used to tighten skin and help active ingredients absorb. Often done as a course.

services.name: Jet Plasma ozone - a cycle of 3
services.desc: A course of three Jet Plasma Ozone sessions at a set price, for a more cumulative result.

services.name: Jet Plasma Ozone - Cycle of 6
services.desc: A course of six Jet Plasma Ozone sessions at a set price, for the fullest result.

services.name: Plumping and tightening
services.desc: A treatment aimed at restoring volume and firmness to a hollow or sagging face. Assessed at consultation.

services.name: Ultraformer Non-Surgical Face Lift
services.desc: Focused ultrasound that reaches deeper layers of the skin to lift and tighten the full face without surgery. Results build over weeks; suitability is assessed first.

services.name: Ultraformer Neck Lift
services.desc: The Ultraformer ultrasound treatment focused on the neck to firm loose or crepey skin.

services.name: Ultraformer Double Chin
services.desc: The Ultraformer ultrasound treatment focused under the chin and jawline.

services.name: Microdermabrasion

services.name: Shaving Time
services.desc: A short add-on appointment for facial shaving and tidying. Book alongside another treatment where possible.

services.name: Spicules
services.desc: A resurfacing treatment using natural marine spicules to exfoliate and renew the skin over the following days.

services.name: Peel (ANESI)
services.desc: A professional ANESI peel, with strength tailored to your skin. Some light flaking over the following days is normal.

services.name: Melaclear
services.desc: A treatment aimed at uneven tone and dark marks. Suitability depends on your skin type and is assessed first.

services.name: X-FC
services.desc: A concentrated corrective facial treatment. Your therapist will confirm at consultation whether it suits your skin.

services.name: Lifting:tightening full face + neck
services.desc: A firming treatment covering the full face and neck together, for skin that has started to lose its hold. Assessed at consultation.

services.name: Plasma Single Treatment
services.desc: A single plasma session rather than a course. A consultation and patch test are required beforehand.

services.name: HIFU Lifting Facial
services.desc: Focused ultrasound delivered as a facial, working deeper than a surface treatment. Results build gradually over weeks.

services.name: Under Eye Bags / Lifting Lines
services.desc: A targeted treatment for puffiness and fine lines under the eye. Suitability is assessed first.

services.name: Keloid
services.desc: Treatment of raised keloid scarring. A consultation is required to confirm the area is suitable to treat.

services.name: Reflexology

services.name: Body Polish
services.desc: A full-body exfoliating scrub followed by hydration, leaving skin soft, smooth and glowing.

services.name: Body Vajacial

services.name: Cellulite Treatment

services.name: Heat Lipolysis Contour Therapy
services.desc: A warmth-based contouring treatment for stubborn areas, usually done as a course.

services.name: Body Skin Tightening (per area)

services.name: Saggy Upper Arms

services.name: Dark Area Treatment (per area)
